title: Full-stack task manager
summary: A Trello-style board where users sign up, create boards and drag tasks between columns.
steps: Build a REST API in Node.js for users, boards and tasks, stored in MongoDB
Add sign-up and login with hashed passwords and tokens
Build the React front end with drag-and-drop between columns
Deploy the API and the front end, and link the live demo in the README
bullet: Built a full-stack task manager (React, Node.js, MongoDB) with auth and drag-and-drop boards, deployed with a live demo.

title: Job board with search and filters

Build the React + TypeScript UI with filters kept in the URL
Run everything locally with Docker Compose and add a README with screenshots
bullet: Developed a TypeScript job board (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) with full-text search and filters, containerised with Docker Compose.

Write tests for the cart logic and deploy the site
bullet: Developed an online store in Django and PostgreSQL with cart, checkout and admin management, covered by unit tests.

title: Library management REST service

Write JUnit tests and document the API with OpenAPI

title: Real-time chat app

Build the React UI with rooms and typing indicators
bullet: Developed a real-time chat app (React, Node.js, WebSockets) with MongoDB history and Redis pub/sub for scaling.

title: GraphQL API for a recipe app

title: Admin dashboard in Angular

title: Weather and air-quality app in Vue

title: Personal portfolio website

Host it on GitHub Pages with your own domain

title: Blog with comments in PHP

title: iOS budget app

Fetch exchange rates from a public REST API
Add charts by category and share a demo video in the README
bullet: Built an iOS budgeting app in Swift and SwiftUI with on-device storage, currency conversion and category charts.

title: Sales performance dashboard
summary: Turn a public sales dataset into a one-page dashboard with insights.

Build a Power BI dashboard with slicers by region and month
Write a one-page summary of findings and recommendations

title: Data story in Tableau Public

title: Financial model and budget forecast
